source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Shrubby small tree to ca. 6 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Pinnately compound, usually (15–)17–23 leaflets, typically to 15(–17) mm wide (genus key)
morphology_documented.fruit: Usually 20 mm or less diameter; nut with regular longitudinal ridges/grooves, edible kernel
morphology_documented.habitat: Limestone outcrops and gravelly stream bottoms

source_scope_note: Genus and key details explicitly noted; where historical flora lacks a species treatment, morphology is limited to independently named secondary sources.

The difference from J. major emphasizes mature fruits and leaflet count rather than leaf presence alone
preservation: Additive, original taxon records, photos, attribution and site unchanged
